finding.headline: "I Don't Think I Can Survive Another Surgery"
finding.problem: "The first time nearly broke me and I had no other kids. How do I do major surgery again with a 2-year-old who needs me? I'm terrified."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"
